name: biobb_mddb DihedralEnergies
title: Wrapper of the Dihedral energies analysis from MDDB workflow module.
description: Calculate the torsion of every dihedral along the trajectory and then the dihedral energies, using the force field parameters in the topology and a sampling of frames.
